flags.title: No certified vacation window
flags.detail: No 7-, 14- or 21-day sports-free trip can currently be certified for 2027–2029. Coverage of all requested leagues and local broadcasts is incomplete. Empty results are unknown, never free.

flags.title: 2028–2029 schedule coverage
flags.detail: MLB feed returned zero games for these calendar years at collection. This does not establish that no games will occur, or that no official dates exist elsewhere. NFL and college-football future full schedules are not verified here. Dates remain blank.

flags.title: NFL future and special-event coverage incomplete
flags.detail: Official 2026 NFL pages yielded 321 distinct game records: 272 regular-season and 49 preseason fixtures. Curated 49ers and Westwood One listings add local evidence and national airtimes. Pro Bowl, 2027–2029 season fixtures and complete postseason game-level details remain unverified. Unknown dates remain unplaced.

flags.title: Westwood One local carriage unresolved
flags.detail: All 46 upcoming NFL slots visible on the reviewed national page were transcribed, but their Bay Area affiliate assignments were not verified. General Westwood One Sports talk programming is not live play-by-play. No national slot is labeled confirmed local radio without separate evidence.

flags.title: Broadcast end times are unknown
flags.detail: MLB 158-minute historical average is used only in a separate planning overlay. NFL/NCAAF 180-minute and NBA 150-minute overlays are assumptions, not verified average durations. They include halftime, not added twice. Overtime, delays, pregame and postgame can extend the conflict.

flags.title: Pregame and postgame coverage
flags.detail: 49ers official partner page describes a three-hour pregame show. Radio-mode calculations include that lead-in for game-specific 49ers records; postgame ends and other teams’ pregame coverage remain unknown. No exact on-air free minute can be certified.

flags.title: TBD is not midnight
flags.detail: MLB startTimeTBD records have no verified start. Placeholder timestamps are discarded. Unknown-time fixtures make the entire calendar date uncertain; 49ers Week 18 also has an unknown date.

flags.title: Stanford ambiguous kickoff

flags.title: Additional local sports coverage incomplete
flags.detail: Warriors games are high priority. Their schedule import is partial. Stanford basketball and KZSU sports, Westwood One basketball, golf, soccer and NCAA championships require current event-level local carriage research. Other Bay Area live sports cannot yet be ruled out.

flags.title: 94122 reception is not guaranteed
flags.detail: Official affiliation establishes a broadcast outlet, not reception at a specific address. Terrain, building construction, antenna and interference matter. Internet streams, satellite and HD-only subchannels do not qualify as ordinary AM/FM reception.

flags.title: Season affiliation ≠ game confirmation
flags.detail: Giants, Athletics and Stanford station listings are shown in the radio guide, not automatically copied onto every game. Spring-training carriage, preemptions and future rights are unverified.

flags.title: Future postseason and special events
flags.detail: 2027 MLB feed currently contains no postseason games. All-Star Game is present, but the Home Run Derby and every other special event are not comprehensively covered by the game feed. A normal schedule gap is not proof of no programming.

flags.title: No synthetic fixtures
flags.detail: The final instruction to leave unconfirmed fields blank takes precedence over the earlier request to estimate unreleased schedules. No invented opponents, dates or TBD kickoff times are inserted. Duration estimates live only in the labeled planning overlay.

flags.title: Conflicting earlier-session all-clear claims
flags.detail: Preserved root windows.html, summary.html and data/calendar.json contain earlier-session verified/all-clear labels for July 12–14, 2027 and February 15–18, 2027. The July 13 All-Star Game directly contradicts the July all-clear claim. February’s four dates are not certified against Warriors or all other radio sports. Their 2028–2029 scenarios and assertion that no trip exists are not verified conclusions. Additive notices link these pages here; original work is preserved for review.

flags.title: Repeated MLB game IDs in source history
flags.detail: The 2026 full-year feed repeats some game IDs for postponed/rescheduled or suspended/resumed appearances. Source occurrences are retained with distinct record IDs, not counted as distinct matchups. Canceled, postponed and suspended entries do not create modeled intervals; official game IDs and source URLs are preserved.
